tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All Terms and Conditions as per Tender Document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Prescribed Tender Form-A, filled out with complete information

Certified records detailing the provision of personnel services to various government departments as an outsourcing agency over the past three years, along with certificates of satisfactory service from the organizations that availed these services, and other documents as specified in Part A of the tender form.
Details regarding registration under the Karnataka Shops and Commercial Establishments Act, 1961 (a copy of the registration certificate must be attached)
The prevailing Contract Labour (Regulation and Abolition) Act, 1970 (a copy must be attached)
Service Tax registration details and a copy of GST-3 returns for the latest one-year period (a certified copy must be attached)
Details of the code number obtained under the EPF Act, information regarding EPF returns filed for the most recent year, and the attachment of Form 6A (please attach a copy).
Attach a copy of the ESI code number details and the ESI returns filed for the last 6 months. (Please attach a copy)
Professional Tax registration details and the clearance certificate for the year 2025-26 (the certificate must be attached)
PAN card details, Income Tax returns (Form 26AS) for the last 3 years, GST returns for the last 3 years, and Balance Sheets for the last 3 years (all must be attached)
Details regarding the provision of outsourced services to various government/semi-government organizations over the last 3 years (a certificate of confirmation must be attached)

Details regarding the human resource services currently being provided by the tenderer to various government organizations in the current year (copies of the work orders from these organizations must be attached) are required. Additionally, experience certificates from the organizations served over the past three years confirming the successful provision of services must be submitted. Furthermore, an experience certificate must be attached demonstrating that an average of 50 personnel per year were provided for at least 3 out of the last 5 years.
Please attach certified copies of bank challans confirming the payment of at least Rs. 3.00 lakh towards service tax and Rs. 5.00 lakh towards the provident fund for the year 2025-26.
Registered under the Private Security Agency Rules, 2005 & the Karnataka Private Security Agency Act, 2008.
